title: B2B Lead & Ad Pixel Enricher Input

domains.title: Domains or URLs
domains.description: Paste company domains (e.g., example.com) or URLs. Duplicates and subpaths are automatically normalized to unique root domains.

scanContactPages.title: Scan Contact & About Pages
scanContactPages.description: Automatically visit /contact, /impressum, or /about pages to find additional emails and phone numbers.

unpackGtmContainers.title: Unpack Google Tag Manager (GTM) Containers
unpackGtmContainers.description: Downloads raw GTM container scripts to detect Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google Ads pixels injected via GTM without needing a headless browser.

defaultPhoneRegion.title: Default Country Code for Local Phones
defaultPhoneRegion.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., US, GB, DE, UA, PL) used to validate local phone numbers written without a '+' country prefix.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings to bypass rate limits or Cloudflare blocks on large lists.
